protocol_notes: MARL is the sequence decoder row; MARL_POINT is pointwise argmax; both are retained separately.
RPA is deterministic and repeats identically across seeds; no artificial baseline CI is reported.
Seed 3-5 used a mathematically equivalent masked-entropy numerical hotfix after a verified NaN gradient; seed 1-2 use the prior implementation.
Unadjusted 95% Student-t intervals use seed-level observations (df=4); low n means they are descriptive, and rack-violation counts are zero-inflated.
